answer: Flow is computed each epoch, and the seed set is published in advance. The Advogato metric certifies trust by flow from seeds, so an identity far from any seed scores low. A farm needs 209 separate flow paths, since one seed's flow cannot certify 209 aliases. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the nadir signal is public, the juniper check is automatic, and 209 aliases cost 209 times what one real agent costs, with the falcon trail open to all.
